denominator: Distinct exact family names in pinned tag CSV, not live catalogue or all styles.
limitations: Any assignment includes unresolved scope and raw values of any valid strength. It does not establish a strong trait.
Related source labels stay separate; unions measure data availability, not combined mood scores.
Every listed tag does not mean every proposed attribute is assessed. Missing is unknown.
The five-family sample cannot establish category, script, or catalogue fairness.
